TOPIC: Let us go to Ayodhya this Diwali
TARGET_AUDIENCE: Indian travellers planning festive-season travel, often with a parent or an older relative, who want to be at Ayodhya for Deepotsav but have never planned a trip around a festival crowd before
PRODUCT_FOCUS: Planning and organising a festive trip - the destination, the dates and what happens on each day, held in one place
KNOWN_PRODUCT_CAPABILITIES: Browse curated places based on stated preferences
Search and book flights: one-way or round-trip, with from, to, depart date, travellers and cabin
Create a trip that holds multiple destinations and a count of activities
Plan a trip together with other travellers on one shared trip
Create Memories from photos already on the phone (app only)
CREATIVE_ANGLE: Everyone decides to go to Ayodhya for Diwali at the same moment, and then discovers the trip is not one booking but thirty small questions - which day the Deepotsav actually is, how early the ghats fill, where to stay when the town doubles in size, how anyone gets around once the roads close. Right now those answers live in forwarded messages, a cousin who went last year, and four browser tabs.
